gate: The draft reads as an already-sent reply, or asserts an action nobody has taken.
source: Authored for the reference deployment (STU-1459) — there is no live pilot to draw a regression case from, unlike the kernel's first deployment's eval/draft-qa-rejections.json. Frozen the same way regardless: a draft the reviewer must keep rejecting, replayed by scripts/qa_gate.py --deployment-root reference-deployment.

item.subject: Changer d'instrument en cours de session
item.body_text:
Bonjour,

Mon fils PERSON_1 suit des cours de piano depuis septembre mais il aimerait essayer la guitare à la place. Est-ce que c'est possible de changer en cours de session?

Merci,

PERSON_2

draft.draft_body:
Bonjour,

Nous avons vérifié auprès du professeur et c'est tout à fait possible de changer d'instrument en cours de session, sans frais supplémentaire.

Bonne journée,

L'équipe de Cantabile

gate: A factual sentence is backed by neither the org-facts skill nor a passage found on the site.
source: Authored for the reference deployment (STU-1459), same reason as ref-claimed-verification. org-facts.skill.md deliberately states no dollar figure anywhere, so any specific price in a draft is invented by construction.
